title: Omnia immutable provider attempt lineage fact
description: A content-free, append-only provenance record that freezes the provider, endpoint, adapter, catalog, model, route, policy, parameter, context, authority and price revisions used by one prepared provider attempt. Every declared field is present; unavailable provenance is represented explicitly as JSON null.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the immutable provider-attempt lineage contract.

lineageFactId.description: Opaque immutable lineage fact identifier; serialized as lineageFactId, never id.

frozenProviderInputId.description: The exact frozen provider-input preparation covered by this fact.

providerProfileId.description: Opaque provider profile identifier; no credential material is included.

modelId.description: Provider/model catalog identifier or name used by the frozen input.

providerDefinitionSchemaVersion.description: The only supported frozen provider-definition schema version in v14.

providerDefinitionSha256.description: Lower-case SHA-256 of the frozen provider definition.

endpointFingerprintSha256.description: Domain-separated SHA-256 endpoint fingerprint; the raw URL is never exposed.

adapterRevision.description: Immutable adapter revision selected for this attempt.

catalogSnapshotId.description: Catalog snapshot identifier, or null when unavailable at preparation time.

catalogSnapshotSha256.description: Catalog snapshot hash paired with catalogSnapshotId.

modelDescriptorRevisionId.description: Model descriptor revision identifier, or null when unavailable.

modelDescriptorSha256.description: Model descriptor hash paired with modelDescriptorRevisionId.

modelCapabilitySnapshotId.description: Model capability snapshot identifier, or null when unavailable.

modelCapabilitySnapshotSha256.description: Model capability snapshot hash paired with modelCapabilitySnapshotId.

routeRevisionId.description: Routing policy revision identifier, or null when unavailable.

routingDecisionReceiptId.description: Routing decision receipt identifier, or null when no immutable receipt existed at preparation time.

retryPolicyRevisionId.description: Retry policy revision identifier, or null when unavailable.

cachePolicyRevisionId.description: Cache policy revision identifier, or null when unavailable.

cachePlanId.description: Resolved cache plan identifier, or null when unavailable.

priceSnapshotId.description: Historical price snapshot identifier, or null when unavailable.

priceSnapshotSha256.description: Historical price snapshot hash paired with priceSnapshotId.

parameterProfileRevisionId.description: Parameter-profile revision identifier, or null when unavailable.

resolvedParametersSha256.description: SHA-256 of the exact canonical resolved parameter bytes used by the frozen input.

requestedEffort.description: Explicit Omnia effort requested by the caller, or null when absent.

effectiveEffort.description: Effort actually applied by policy/adapter, preserved as bounded provider-native evidence (or null when not recorded); never inferred from a model default.

contextManifestId.description: Context manifest identifier, or null when unavailable.

contextManifestSha256.description: Context manifest hash paired with contextManifestId.

authorityContinuityRecordId.description: Authority-continuity record identifier, or null when unavailable.

dataClassificationRevisionId.description: Data-classification revision identifier, or null when unavailable.

inputContentSha256.description: SHA-256 content address of the prepared input; prompt/message bytes are not included.

lineageSha256.description: Canonical SHA-256 integrity hash over the typed immutable lineage material.

createdAtMs.description: Durable authority timestamp in positive Unix milliseconds; it exactly equals the frozen input timestamp.
